SELECT COUNT(*) AS usageCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.send_status = 'COPIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS copiedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.send_status = 'SDK_SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sdkSuccessCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.send_status = 'SDK_FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sdkFailedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.send_status = 'SDK_UNKNOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sdkUnknownCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.edited = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS editedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.ai_suggestion_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS aiLinkedUsageCount FROM crm_quick_reply_usage u JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND c.id = u.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.created_at >= #{fromUtc} AND u.created_at < #{toUtcExclusive}
AND u.employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS generatedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND s.accepted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS acceptedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rejectedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'PROPOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND s.accepted = 1 AND s.edited = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS editedAcceptedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.provider = 'mock' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS mockGeneratedCount FROM crm_ai_reply_suggestion s JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND c.id = s.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.created_at >= #{fromUtc} AND s.created_at < #{toUtcExclusive}
AND s.employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.send_status = 'COPIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS copiedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.send_status = 'SDK_SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sdkSuccessCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.send_status = 'SDK_FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sdkFailedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.send_status = 'SDK_UNKNOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sdkUnknownCount FROM crm_quick_reply_usage u JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND c.id = u.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.ai_suggestion_id IS NOT NULL AND u.created_at >= #{fromUtc} AND u.created_at < #{toUtcExclusive}
AND u.employee_id = #{employeeId}

WITH appointment_events AS ( SELECT h.tenant_id, h.appointment_id, MIN(CASE WHEN h.to_status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN h.created_at END) AS confirmed_at, MIN(CASE WHEN h.to_status = 'CHECKED_IN' THEN h.created_at END) AS checked_in_at FROM crm_appointment_history h WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY h.tenant_id, h.appointment_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS confirmedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.checked_in_at IS NOT NULL AND e.checked_in_at >= e.confirmed_at AND e.checked_in_at < #{toUtcExclusive} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS checkedInCount FROM appointment_events e JOIN crm_appointment a ON a.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND a.id = e.appointment_id JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND c.id = a.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE e.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND e.confirmed_at >= #{fromUtc} AND e.confirmed_at < #{toUtcExclusive}
AND a.owner_staff_id = #{employeeId}

WITH order_facts AS ( SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, MIN(p.confirmed_at) AS first_confirmed_at FROM crm_payment_txn p JOIN crm_order o ON o.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND o.id = p.order_id AND o.status IN ('PAID', 'PARTIALLY_REDEEMED', 'FULFILLED') JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND c.id = o.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND p.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND p.confirmed_at >= #{fromUtc} AND p.confirmed_at < #{toUtcExclusive}
AND o.owner_at_sale_id = #{employeeId} GROUP BY o.id, o.customer_id ), customer_facts AS ( SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS paid_orders FROM order_facts GROUP BY customer_id ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.paid_orders), 0) AS paidOrderCount, COUNT(*) AS paidCustomerCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.paid_orders > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS repeatCustomerCount FROM customer_facts f
